rule: doc_overlap_guard/v1: 13-gram (attack_guard.normalise, no leaf crossing) row document vs Index eval units (DEV+TEST+held-out); FAIL if covered >= 0.5 of the row's grams (R) or of an eval unit's grams (E), or the draw covers >= 0.5 of a unit and the row >= 0.25 of it (U); min 3 covered grams, (E)/(U) units >= 5 grams; boilerplate = eval df > 1% AND train df > 1%, or both df >= 10, or eval df >= 100 (templates); reviewed allowlist of shared public corpora; units over 256-unit df skip (E)/(U)
